bug_title: Login fails when username is null
bug_report:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "username" is null
    at com.necn.auth.AuthenticationService.authenticate(AuthenticationService.java:45)
    at com.necn.controller.LoginController.login(LoginController.java:28)
    at com.necn.service.LoginService.processLogin(LoginService.java:72)
    at org.springframework.web.servlet.FrameworkServlet.doPost(FrameworkServlet.java:1014)
    at org.springframework.web.servlet.FrameworkServlet.service(FrameworkServlet.java:895)

triage.reasoning: The login authentication process is failing because the user object is null.

triage_analysis.reasoning: The login authentication process is failing because the user object is null.

issues.error_message: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.equals(Object)" because "username" is null
issues.root_cause: The username value is null before the authentication logic attempts to access it. The input should be validated before authentication.
issues.suggested_fix: Validate the object or value for null before accessing it.
